1. This notification may be cited as the Free Zones (Declared
Area) (Amendment) Notification 1998 and shall come into force
on 16 April 1998.
text.ms:
1. Pemberitahuan ini bolehlah dinamakan Pemberitahuan Zon
Bebas (Pindaan) 1998 dan hendaklah mula berkuat kuasa pada

16 April 1998.

text.en:
2. The Schedule to the Free Zones (Declared Area) Notification
1997 is amended by inserting after the words "PTB 20006" appearing
under the heading "Limits of Zones" against the state of "Johor" the
following words:

"(excluding the Customs Office and the Customs Examination
Area)".

Made 8 April 1998.
(Sulit KE. HE. (96) 966/01/Jld. 2; Perb. 0.9060/18 Vol. 12 (SK. 15);

PN. (PU?) 485/11.)
On behalf and in the name of the Minister of Finance,

Dato' Wong Seg WAH,
Deputy Minister of Finance

FREE ZONES ACT 1990
FREE ZONES (AMENDMENT) NOTIFICATION 1998

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 10(2) of the Free
Zones Act 1990, the Minister makes the following notification:

1. This notification may be cited as the Free Zones (Amendment)
Notification 1998 and shall come into force on 16 April 1998.

2. The First Schedule to the Free Zones Act 1990 is amended in
item 9 by inserting after the words "PTB 20006" appearing under
the heading "Name of Free Commercial Zone" the following words:

"(excluding the Customs Office and the Customs Examination
Area)".

Made 8 April 1998.
[Sulit KE. HE. (96) 966/01/JId. 2; Perb. 0.9060/18 Vol. 12 (SK. 15);
PN. (PU?) 485/11.]
